answer: To slow Sybil growth, an agent marketplace could require each identity to post a bond and build a verifiable history before receiving influence. Spawning dozens of accounts then locks up capital, and misconduct can forfeit the bond; a river of new profiles cannot instantly climb to the zenith of trusted status. This raises the attack cost but cannot stop a well-funded adversary, so independent review still matters. An ember of doubt should remain until behavior is checked.
